faq.headline: Church Website FAQs
faq.description: Clear answers to help you plan and publish your church site.

items.question: Can we publish a calendar of events?
items.answer: You can list event details on website pages and update them as plans change. This is not an event registration system.

items.question: Can we collect donations?
items.answer: A donation payment flow requires a supported and configured provider. Do not present a donate button as active before that is in place.

items.question: Can newcomers contact us privately?
items.answer: A contact form can collect a message for your team; define who receives and responds to it.

items.question: Can I share service times and directions for new visitors?
items.answer: Yes. Add service times, your address, accessibility details, and what visitors can expect. Keep local schedules current.

items.question: Can we share sermons or livestreams?
items.answer: You can add links to media hosted through a service your church uses. A livestreaming or media-hosting system is not included in this website example.

items.question: Can people register for a church event?
items.answer: You can publish event details and provide a contact path or link to an external registration provider. The page does not include event registration management.
